name: FORTIFIED BOX DEFENSE
situation_report: Enemy forces have created a fortified 'box' position with all-around defenses. This strongpoint blocks our advance and must be reduced. The position is heavily mined and wired, with prepared gun positions covering all approaches. Historical examples: Gazala boxes, Tobruk perimeter strongpoints.
tactical_context: Breaking a fortified box requires overwhelming force, careful breaching of minefields, and accepting heavy casualties. The defender has prepared fields of fire and can engage from all sides. Artillery and engineer support are essential.

terrain_features.name: Perimeter Defenses
terrain_features.description: Minefields, barbed wire, defensive positions forming a box
terrain_features.special_rules: Minefield (dangerous terrain). Wire (difficult terrain). Trenches (hard cover).

terrain_features.name: Command Post
terrain_features.special_rules: Hard cover with +1 cover save. Primary objective.

terrain_features.name: Gun Positions
terrain_features.special_rules: Hard cover, prepared fields of fire.

terrain_notes: Central fortified box with mines, wire, and dug-in positions

effects: Desert Dust Cloud begins on turn 9
From turn 9: Maximum artillery spotter range 40"

victory_conditions:
**Attacker Victory**: Capture command post AND 1+ gun position.

**Defender Victory**: Hold command post OR attacker reaches BR limit.

**Draw**: Attacker breaches perimeter but cannot take command post.
deployment_steps: Place 18" × 18" fortified box in table center
Place minefields and wire around perimeter
Place command post in center, gun positions at corners
Defender deploys all units inside box (dug in)
Attacker chooses which table edge(s) to attack from

deployment_zones.location: All table edges except within 12" of box
special_rules: May choose which edge(s) to attack from
Must breach perimeter to reach objectives
All units start dug-in (+1 cover save)
Prepared fields of fire (re-roll missed AT shots turn 1-2)

objectives.spacing_rules: Command post + 2 corner gun positions = 3 objectives

special_rules: **Fortified Box**: Defender's units start dug-in (+1 cover save)
**Minefields**: D6 per unit entering, 6 = immobilized vehicle or pinned infantry
**Barbed Wire**: Difficult terrain, infantry may cut (requires turn in contact)
**Prepared Defense**: Defender re-rolls missed AT shots turns 1-2
**All-Around Defense**: Defender can face any direction without penalty
**Breakthrough Required**: Attacker must breach perimeter and reach objectives
